_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
SysID keeps the acceptance decision, independent band checks and missing low-pressure measurements visible above its detailed results. Rejected scans cannot supply accepted tuning.

PID adds a read-only NI pressure-fall trend and reported valve demand versus delivered duty. Dormant position-PID components are hidden during measured-rate deflation; exact active gains and pulse-filter lock remain explicitly unavailable.

Simulator MAP results show accepted firmware MAP and measured cuff hold separately, with sensor and cuff provenance. CVP rows are excluded from MAP accuracy accounting. Startup navigation now preserves an early tab selection. Offline pressure defaults to the calibrated NI sensor used by live BPF, and the legacy causal filter is labelled with its phase delay.

This Default GUI-only update retains followup-288 firmware, the five presets, controller parameters, SysID estimator and accepted calibrations. Controller/MAP/SysID research candidates are not included. Same-input BPF agreement does not establish physical pulse preservation or independent arterial MAP accuracy.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
